Philosophy\n\n### Why This Structure?\n\n✅ **Separation of Concerns**\n- Backend logic separate from frontend\n- Data files separate from code\n- Configuration files grouped\n\n✅ **Scalability**\n- Easy to add new routes\n- Easy to add new components\n- Easy to add new data\n\n✅ **Maintainability**\n- Clear file purposes\n- Organized imports\n- Logical grouping\n\n✅ **Development Speed**\n- Quick to find files\n- Easy to make changes\n- Fast feedback loop\n\n---\n\n## Key Files You'll Edit\n\n### Priority 1 (Edit First)\n```\nserver/data/personal.json       ← YOUR PERSONAL INFO\nserver/data/projects.json       ← YOUR PROJECTS\nserver/data/skills.json         ← YOUR SKILLS\nserver/data/education.json      ← YOUR EDUCATION\n```\n\n### Priority 2 Modify styling if desired\nclient/tailwind.config.js       ← Change colors/fonts\n```\n\n### Don't Edit (Working Fine)\n```\nserver/index.js                 ← API is complete\nclient/src/App.jsx              ← Component structure is final\nAll other config files          ← Pre-configured correctly\n```\n\n---\n\n## How to Navigate the Files\n\n### Understanding Data Flow\n1. User visits http://localhost:5173\n2. React loads (App.jsx)\n3. Components mount (Hero, About, etc.)\n4. useEffect triggers in each component\n5. Component calls `portfolioAPI.getSomething()`\n6. API utility makes fetch request\n7. Backend receives request at server/index.js\n8. Backend reads JSON file from server/data/\n9. Backend sends JSON response\n10. Component updates state with data\n11. Component re-renders with data\n12. User sees dynamic content\n\n### Adding a New Feature\n1. Update JSON data file (if needed)\n2. Create/update API endpoint in server/index.js\n3. Create component or update existing in client/src/components/\n4. Add useEffect to fetch data\n5. Render component in App.jsx\n6. Test in browser\n7. Commit to Git\n\n### Deploying Changes\n1. Update your data/code locally\n2. Test thoroughly\n3. Push to GitHub\n4. Vercel auto-deploys frontend\n5. Railway auto-deploys backend\n6. Live site updates automatically\n\n---\n\n## File Access URLs\n\n### Development\n```\nFrontend:       http://localhost:5173\nBackend:        http://localhost:5000\nAPI Docs:
